query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(address)) >= 15) AS active_with_nontrivial_address, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE latitude IS NULL OR longitude IS NULL) AS active_without_exact_coordinates, COUNT(*) AS active_total FROM public.providers WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(status, 'active'))) = 'active'; SELECT id, provider_name, lga, address, latitude, longitude FROM public.providers WHERE provider_name ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%ADULOJU%', '%AKINTAN%', '%BOLCOM%', '%BETAK%', '%NETCARE%', '%SIJUADE%', '%ST MICHAEL%', '%GENERAL HOSPITAL IGBOKODA%', '%GENERAL HOSPITAL IJU%', '%GENERAL HOSPITAL ORE%', '%PIMA HOSPITAL%']) ORDER BY provider_name LIMIT 30; SELECT latitude, longitude, COUNT(*) AS provider_count FROM public.providers WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(status, 'active'))) = 'active' AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY latitude, longitude HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY provider_count DESC LIMIT 20;
